lines.1: I showed my face at the executive-committee room.
lines.4: I'd somehow picked up a weird nickname.
lines.5: 「You seem to be getting along quite well with Konoe-san from Class 2-A.」
lines.6: 「Saw you two having a nice little chase, kid.」
lines.7: D-damn. I'd been watched by a bird from up in the sky.
lines.8: 「I'll reproduce that line you just said with a perfect vocal imitation.」
lines.10: 「Ugh, gross! Especially that last laugh! That's nasty!」
lines.13: 「And because you're so very you, Tsushima-kun, your nickname is Rom-Com Boy.」
lines.14: First Hustle Boy, now Rom-Com Boy.
lines.15: 「May I spread that line around the entire school?」
lines.17: 「I'll settle for four thousand yen a month.」
lines.18: And now I was being extorted.
lines.22: 「For now, I just want to sit down and calm down.」
lines.23: 「There's no seat for you here anymore!」
lines.28: 「What, Tsushima-kun? You like that twin-tail girl?」
lines.29: 「Twin-tails are a hairstyle you hardly ever see in the real world! And you--!」
lines.31: 「Konoe and I have known each other forever. We just made up, that's all.」
lines.32: 「Is it just me, or is Leo kind of popular?」
lines.33: 「All right, impromptu survey! Everybody help me out.」
lines.34: 「Me or Leo. Which one do you think is cooler?」
lines.35: 「Don't worry about either of our feelings. Just answer honestly.」
lines.44: 「Tsushima-kun, please keep doing your best from now on. (smile)」
lines.45: 「You're acting even weirder than usual. You okay?」
lines.49: 「He said not to look for him.」
lines.51: 「Kukuku. What a ridiculous primate that guy is.」
lines.52: Unlike the drama club, everyone here was merciless.
